reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve been in contact with their support team for 4-5 months trying to get incorrect information removed from my stats. They have asked me to send screen recordings numerous times which I did. After months of back and forth I asked them to manually remove the incorrect items which they still haven’t done. Meanwhile I’ve been using the app for close to 6-7 years and paying for the premium version. I asked them for refunds which they told me to get from Apple and Apple was only able to refund one month. If you can’t fix bugs in your app that’s on you and your responsibility to fix not the customers responsibility. If someone is paying for premium you should be able to resolve the issue in a timely manner not 4-5 months. I’ve been using the app and paying for it for years to now have to switch to something new with better support. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: We just want to walk not fix issues
reviews.text: Pacer isn’t as easy as it appears.  It has similarities to Duolingo and Fitbit.  Creating a challenge is overly complicated.  You invite your friends and you must invite again each time to participate in a challenge. You have to create a club and then within the club you create challenges.  Each challenge you need to send a link for your friends to participate.  Some are experiencing tech challenges because the link doesn’t work or their devices aren’t syncing or the steps are wrong.  Very disappointed because friends are not participating due to the issues.

reviews.title: Walking, running
reviews.text:
I assumed it was the best app ever for encouraging you to walk, but when you’ve been using and paying a subscription for an app for over three years you expect the app not to cheat. I would like to request a full refund, please.

Today, I started a new adventure and successfully passed the checkpoint to earn my league points, but the promised 51 points were never credited to my account. Yesterday, I also lost 80 points, meaning 131 points have now gone missing in just two days.

This is completely unacceptable. I am a Pacer Premium subscriber, paying for a service that is failing to deliver what it promises. Quite frankly, it feels as though your app is cheating its paying customers.

What is the point of paying for a Premium subscription if the points I earn are not being awarded?

I am extremely dissatisfied with this experience and would like a full refund of my subscription fees. Please investigate these missing points and confirm how you intend to resolve this matter.

reviews.title: Needs Improvement
reviews.text: Signed up and I’ve tracked 35.6 miles on my watch in the last five days -one day after starting one of the pacer challenges. I train like an athlete daily and this app says I’ve only done 6 miles. I’ve kept the app open, draining my battery, to avoid disconnecting my watch. This app wants you to use your phone everywhere. If you’re working outdoors and that’s part of your routine - I’m talking about building retaining walls and all that - most of us don’t keep our phones nor our watches on us and this app won’t allow you to credit yourself for that workout. I signed up and in order to see my progress, I paid a subscription fee for one month. Once I’m done with this review, I’m canceling. How do I walk 36 miles on my watch and iPhone without personal input and this app only registers 6? And it’s still not moving. It’s been two days since it’s moved. I know I’m always active because of my job and my home gym however the app is not built for people like me. Go somewhere else and see your real progress. This app needs a lot of work before you get on it. 36 miles in my watch but only 6 on pacer? Nope. Don’t waste your time or money on it. They need to fix this because I paid to join a challenge I should have finished after 16 miles. I’m at 36 miles and my location hasn’t moved. The developers need to learn to do the math. It’s not rocket science, Devs. Get it together. Can’t even recommend this app to anyone because it doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Change my life
reviews.text:
This app remain on my lockscreen and homepage main app I visit time and again daily.  My 10k steps challenge is way now I regularly hit 25k plus daily and the app always log every steps from walking in kitchen to out door walks.  Brilliant.  Update weight etc all as premium well worth getting the extra features break down your weekly best what you have done etc on Monday morning.  Tremendous app.  Well done. Fix the app it no longer should what did the day before etc timer keep resetting

reviews.title: Newest update only supports Garmin or Apple Watch
reviews.text: The newest update has gotten rid of the ability to connect to my fitness tracker directly through Google Health. I now have to sync my steps with either my phone as the pedometer, or Apple Health. This is a huge problem from me as I can’t carry my phone with me at work, and Apple Health will not sync with Google Health. Apple Health defaults to Apple devices, even when I moved my phone to the lowest priority and moved Google Health to the top priority and have triple checked that the permissions are correct. The end result is that over half of my steps every day are not counted, so the motivation I’ve been getting from keeping my streak going, moving up in leagues, and the virtual challenges has been totally undermined. In other words, the App is now completely useless to me unless I want to shell out for a Garmin or Apple Watch to track my fitness (which I don’t, even if I had the finances to do so). Bring back the ability to sync with Google Health, or I will have to cancel my Premium Subscription and delete the now useless app.

reviews.title: Issues with Pacer reading from Health
reviews.text:
I have been using Pacer for the past 10-12 years and since 2021 as a premium user. I like the app as it is well designed and meets all my needs. The Premium version is full of great features. However, since last summer it started having issues reading data properly from Apple Health. It is missing years of data. For example in 2019 I have walked more than 4 million steps and the app shows 0. So I decided to contact support. I have to say that they are extremely responsive and topically I will get a response the next day. Having said that, the response is completely useless as they basically tell me every time that they can do nothing to fix my issues. For example, to reset my account or to force the app to re-read the data. They basically told me it is impossible and to live with that. The thing is that I have a lifetime license so I am stuck as I don’t want to pay again for another app. So be careful and don’t subscribe for more then a month in order to see if it works well for you.
Cheers
